King City, Oregon

Junk removal in King City

King City is a small city tucked off Highway 99W near the Tualatin River, about twenty seven road miles from our base, in Zone 3. It began as a retirement community, and many homes are single level with carports, alongside newer neighborhoods on its west side.

Downsizing and moves to care homes make up much of our King City work: a bedroom set, a recliner, a dining table and boxes from the hall closet. Single level homes make these jobs quick, and we take care not to scuff walls or floors on the way out.

King City questions

Good to know

Can you pick up a single recliner in King City?

Yes. A single item is our smallest load size, and travel for your zone is added. Snap a photo of it and you will see the price.

Do you protect floors when carrying furniture out?

We carry rather than drag, and we lay down runners on finished floors when a large piece comes through.

Is there a travel charge to King City?

Yes. King City is in our zone 3, so travel adds $50.00 per visit to the load price. It is shown in your price before you book.

Which King City ZIP codes do you cover?

All of these: 97224. Type yours in the quote and the price includes travel.
